answer: Bind each seat to a physical TPM 2.0 chip. To join, a seat sends a quote signed by an attestation key chained to the maker's endorsement-key certificate, plus a hash of that key as a nullifier, so one chip backs one seat. Virtual TPMs carry no maker cert, so a 1,000-clone farm crammed onto one server island needs 1,000 real boards, about $150,000 at $150 each (figures assumed). No ivory-tower crypto: any spare mini PC gives an honest agent a haven.
